overview: Recurring operational control, incident response, trend reporting, changes and service improvement through an agreed rota. The scope is built around network topology, identities and policy rules, producing connectivity architecture, ACL evidence and operational handover. A customer-named network operations manager approves the work. The service-specific assurance focus is network segmentation and outage rollback.
